statement: There exist a four-layer RWKV-7 and a four-layer DeltaNet, over the paper's exact rational architecture definitions, that on every stream of 3x3 matrices over {-1,0,1} output their iterated product at the final position; therefore positivity of entry (0,0) realizes a PNC1-complete language under FO reductions.

universal: every number N >= 1 of input matrices
quantifiers.obligation: Both networks output all nine exact product entries at the final input position.

assumptions: The global BOS convention may supply one initialization step but must be indexed consistently.
RWKV-7 uses the exact DPLR transition in Section 2.
DeltaNet uses H(beta,k)=I-beta kk^T over Q with unrestricted rational beta.
The first three layers must exactly route position and a fixed finite token window for unbounded N.
Caussinus et al. Corollary 3.4 supplies GapNC1 completeness of 3x3 iterated multiplication.

primary_references.title: RWKV-7 Goose with Expressive Dynamic State Evolution

blocker: The DeltaNet proof's two-dimensional rational Householder router cannot realize the required period 1404: a rational 2x2 matrix cannot contain a primitive 1404th root because phi(1404)=432. The paper gives no alternative exact four-layer rational router.
unblock_requirement: An exact four-layer DeltaNet construction over Q with a valid unbounded-position router, or a machine-checkable impossibility proof for every such network.
limitations: Four materially different routes were completed. RWKV is verified after consistent BOS initialization, and DeltaNet's arithmetic program is verified, but the exact conjunctive theorem remains unresolved. The N=1 source-schedule counterexample invalidates that schedule, not every possible four-layer network, so it is not a valid falsification.
